name: Uploading an image to a variant succeeds and image appears in gallery

preconditions.note: Requires a variant to upload to. Creates a test image file during execution.

steps.description: Click the first variant's View Details button
steps.snapshotHint: View Details button in first variant row

steps.description: Click the image upload button to trigger file chooser
steps.snapshotHint: Look for an upload button, camera icon, or p-fileUpload component on the variant detail page

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 100; c.height = 100; const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 100, 100); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.font = '14px Arial'; ctx.fillText('E2E Test', 10, 55); return c.toDataURL('image/png'); })()
steps.description: Generate a test image as base64 data URL

businessContext: Image upload is how new product photos are added — broken upload means stale catalog
